purpose: Suites that exist as npm scripts but run in no workflow lane. A debt register, not an exemption list: scripts/check-e2e-suite-wiring.mjs fails on any suite missing from here, and fails again on any entry that has since been wired or deleted, so this list can only shrink.
note: Every entry predates the gate; none was added to silence a failure. Wiring one is a CI-minute decision owned by the suite area, not by this file. The creation date is in git history rather than duplicated here, where it could only drift. test:e2e:editor-perf is deliberate: it is driven by the D12 evidence regeneration flow (docs/qa/perf-evidence.md), not by a lane.
